grammarFocus: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接。
title: The Community Garden Project: Planning and Checking
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和题目均为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请先通读全文，再作答。答案必须来自原文。
passage:
Last spring, a group of neighbours in a small town decided to turn an empty lot into a community garden. They had a small budget, a few tools, and a lot of enthusiasm. The project leader, Maria, suggested that they divide the work into three stages: planning, planting, and harvesting. At each stage, they would check their progress and decide how to use their resources—time, money, and people—more effectively.

In the planning stage, the group met twice a week. They discussed what to grow and how to share the work. Maria made a simple chart. It showed how many hours each person could volunteer and how much money they could contribute. “If we have enough volunteers, we can plant more vegetables,” she said. “But if we don't check our numbers regularly, we might buy too many seeds.” The group agreed to review the chart every two weeks. This regular check helped them avoid waste. They also learned that some tasks needed more time than others. For example, preparing the soil took longer than they expected. So they adjusted their plan and asked for help from other neighbours.

When the planting stage began, the group faced a problem. They had only two water taps, but ten people wanted to water their plants at the same time. Some members suggested buying more hoses, but that would cost money. Others proposed a schedule: each person could water for thirty minutes, and they would take turns. “If everyone follows the schedule, we will have enough water for all the plants,” said one member. They also decided to collect rainwater in large barrels. This way, they could save money and use fewer resources. The schedule worked well, and the plants got enough water.

As the weeks passed, the garden grew. The group continued to check their progress. They noticed that some plants needed more sun, so they moved them to a different area. They also saw that they had too many tomatoes and not enough lettuce. “If we had known earlier, we would have planted fewer tomatoes,” Maria laughed. “But next year, we can plan better.” They wrote down these lessons in a notebook. They also took photos to compare the plants’ growth each month. These records helped them see which methods worked best.

At the end of the season, the group held a meeting. They counted their harvest: 50 kilograms of tomatoes, 30 kilograms of lettuce, and 20 kilograms of carrots. They also calculated how much money they had spent and how many hours they had volunteered. The numbers showed that they had used their resources well, but they could improve next year. For example, they spent too much on seeds and not enough on tools. They decided to buy better tools and to ask more people to join the garden. They also planned to start earlier next spring so that they would have more time for soil preparation.

The community garden project taught the neighbours an important lesson: regular checks and good planning help us use our resources wisely. Whether we are growing vegetables or managing a project at work, we can always learn from each stage. By sharing their experiences, the neighbours also built stronger friendships and a sense of teamwork. They realised that small, regular checks are more useful than one big check at the end. Next year, they will keep the same three-stage plan, but they will check their progress every week instead of every two weeks. This simple change will help them respond faster to problems and use their time and money even better.

grammar.title: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接
grammar.explanation: 条件句用if引导，表示“如果……就……”。真实条件句：if+一般现在时，主句用will/can等。例如：If we have enough volunteers, we can plant more vegetables. 虚拟条件句（与过去事实相反）：if+过去完成时，主句用would have done。例如：If we had known earlier, we would have planted fewer tomatoes. 数量词如many, much, enough, a few, a lot of等修饰名词。段落间用代词（they, this, these）和连接词（however, for example, as a result）保持衔接。
grammar.example: If we have enough volunteers, we can plant more vegetables.

questions.prompt: If it ______ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
questions.explanation: 真实条件句中，if从句用一般现在时表示将来。
questions.evidence: If we have enough volunteers, we can plant more vegetables.

questions.prompt: She has ______ money, so she can't buy the expensive bag.
questions.explanation: money是不可数名词，用little修饰表示“很少”。

questions.prompt: If I ______ you, I would apologize.
questions.explanation: 虚拟条件句中，与现在事实相反，if从句用were。
questions.evidence: If we had known earlier, we would have planted fewer tomatoes.

questions.prompt: There are ______ people in the room, so we need more chairs.
questions.explanation: people是可数名词复数，用many修饰。
